text: Use a unique 12+ character password for every account. A password manager makes this effortless.
Enable MFA on your email FIRST. Email is the master key to resetting all other passwords.
Prefer authenticator apps (Authy, Google Authenticator, Bitwarden) over SMS for 2FA. SIM swapping defeats SMS.
Use passphrases: 4-5 random words (correct-horse-battery-staple). Easier to remember, high entropy.
Check haveibeenpwned.com quarterly. If your email appears in a breach, change that password immediately.
Hover over links before clicking. The actual destination shows in bottom-left of browser.
Legitimate companies never ask for passwords/OTPs via email, SMS, or phone calls.
Urgency ("act now or account closes") is a major red flag. Legitimate orgs give reasonable time.
Verify unexpected requests through a KNOWN, TRUSTED channel — not contact info in the suspicious message.
QR codes can lead to phishing sites too. Preview the URL before opening after scanning.
Enable automatic updates for OS, browsers, and apps. Patches fix vulnerabilities attackers exploit.
Use full-disk encryption: BitLocker (Windows), FileVault (Mac), LUKS (Linux). Protects data if device stolen.
Separate admin account from daily use. Only log in as admin for installations/updates.
Disable unused services: Bluetooth, file sharing, remote desktop, AirDrop (set to Contacts Only).
Set screen lock to activate after 5 minutes. Use 6+ digit PIN or alphanumeric password.
Use uBlock Origin + Privacy Badger. They block trackers, ads, and fingerprinting scripts.
Switch to privacy search: DuckDuckGo, Brave Search, or Startpage. No search history profiling.
Review app permissions quarterly. Revoke location/mic/camera for apps that don't need them.
Opt out of ad personalization: Google (myactivity.google.com), Meta, Apple, Microsoft, Twitter.
Use email aliases (SimpleLogin, Firefox Relay, AnonAddy) for signups. Protects real email.
Follow 3-2-1: 3 copies, 2 media types, 1 offsite. Example: local drive + cloud + offline USB.
Test restores quarterly. A backup you can't restore is not a backup.
Encrypt backups client-side before cloud upload (Cryptomator, Veracrypt, or E2EE provider).
Keep one backup completely offline (air-gapped). Protects against ransomware encrypting network shares.
Backup password manager vault (encrypted export) to offline storage. Master key recovery.
Only install apps from official stores (Play Store, App Store). Sideloaded apps bypass security review.
Set SIM PIN (Settings → Security → SIM lock). Prevents SIM swap if phone stolen.
Enable "Find My Device" (Android) / "Find My iPhone" (iOS) NOW. Test it works.
Review app permissions after updates. Updates sometimes reset or add new permissions.
Use Google Play Protect / App Store privacy labels. Check "Data Safety" section before install.
Never do sensitive tasks (banking, email) on public Wi-Fi without VPN.
Home Wi-Fi: WPA3 if supported, else WPA2-AES. Change default admin password. Disable WPS.
Use separate guest network for IoT devices (smart bulbs, cameras, printers).
Router firmware updates monthly. Many vulnerabilities patched silently.
Consider DNS over HTTPS (DoH): Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, NextDNS, or Quad9. Encrypts DNS queries.
Never share OTPs. "Bank calling to verify" is always a scam. Banks never ask for OTPs.
Verify identity independently. Call back on official number from website/card — not caller ID.
Gift card / crypto / wire transfer requests = SCAM. No legitimate org asks for these.
Deepfake audio/video calls exist. Establish secret passphrase with family/colleagues for verification.
Limit personal info on social media. Birthdate, pet names, schools = password reset answers.
Never reuse passwords. Credential stuffing uses breached combos on hundreds of sites automatically.
Password manager master password: make it a memorable passphrase, store recovery kit offline.
Check "Reply-To" header. Phishing often shows legitimate "From" but different "Reply-To".
Banking trojans overlay fake login screens. Always check URL bar matches your bank's exact domain.
Use Windows Hello / Touch ID / Face ID. Biometrics + PIN > password alone.
Encrypt external drives (BitLocker To Go, FileVault, Veracrypt). Lost drive = safe data.
Freeze credit with all 4 bureaus (CIBIL, Experian, Equifax, CRIF). Free, doesn't affect score, prevents identity theft.
Use "Sign in with Apple/Google" with "Hide My Email" / email masking when available.
Phone photos: enable Google Photos / iCloud backup. Losing phone shouldn't mean losing memories.
Document your recovery procedure: what to restore, in what order, who to contact. Test it.
Disable "Install Unknown Apps" for all sources except when intentionally sideloading.
Lockdown mode (iOS 16+) / Android 14+ security features for high-risk users (journalists, activists).
IoT devices on guest network. If smart bulb hacked, attacker can't reach your laptop.
Tech support scam: "Microsoft/Apple support" calling you = scam. They NEVER call unprompted.
Rotate passwords after any known breach of a service you use. Password manager makes this 1-click.
Smishing (SMS phishing): "Package delivery failed" links. Track via official carrier app/site only.
Power off (not sleep) laptop when traveling. Sleep keeps encryption keys in RAM (cold boot attack risk).
Delete unused accounts. HaveIBeenPwned "Notify me" alerts you when your email appears in new breaches.
Ransomware encrypts network shares too. Offline backup is your only guarantee.
Report cybercrime: India → cybercrime.gov.in or 1930. US → ic3.gov. UK → actionfraud.police.uk.
